title: The Relate playground: an agent's memory, in your browser
description: A chat on one side, the agent's memory on the other. As the conversation goes on, the agent writes what it learns into Relate 1.2.0, compiled to WebAssembly, and the memory grows as a graph in front of you, drawn with NVL. When it is asked something in a later session, in words it was never told, one statement combines vector search, full-text search and graph hops, and the page highlights the paths that statement returned. The agent's words are scripted; every read and write of its memory is a real statement, run in the tab under a graph type that refuses a malformed memory, and every vector comes from a real embedding model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2). An Ontology tab shows the model that memory keeps to, written as a Neo4j Ontology Graph Spec document: drawn with NVL, searchable, and checked against the store, with the rules the engine does not enforce run as statements. Three conversations to play, then ask your own questions.
summary: Watch an agent build its memory as a graph while it chats, then recall it in a later session. One statement combines vector search, full-text search and graph hops, and the paths it returned light up.
browser: Runs in any current browser with module workers and WebAssembly. The scripted conversations need no download beyond the page, 9 MB (about 3 MB as the server compresses it), most of it the database. Typing your own text fetches a 23 MB embedding model once, cached by the browser, and its 15 MB runtime; without it your text is searched by its words.
credits: Relate 1.2.0 WebAssembly build (Apache-2.0), served here as a pinned copy of npm's @relate/relate-wasm 1.2.0.
NVL 2.0.0, the Neo4j Visualization Library (proprietary), used with Neo4j's permission (confirmed by the repository owner on 2026-10-08).
Transformers.js 4.3.2 (huggingface/transformers.js, Apache-2.0) and the onnxruntime-web WebAssembly build it pins (MIT), bundled from npm.

all-MiniLM-L6-v2 by the sentence-transformers project (Apache-2.0), as the 8-bit quantised ONNX conversion Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, fetched from the Hugging Face Hub at a pinned revision and checked against pinned sha256s; the vectors of the scripted texts were computed with it ahead of time.
Public Sans 5.3.0 and IBM Plex Mono 5.3.0 (SIL Open Font License 1.1), from their fontsource npm packages.

The Relate logo, favicon and mascot, from the Relate brand kit v1.0 (November 2026), supplied by the repository owner and used as the kit's rules say; they are trademarks, not under this repository's licence.

The memory model (messages, entities, memories that supersede one another) and the shape of the recall statement follow Relate's own cookbook recipes on agent memory and hybrid recall (relatedb.ai/cookbook, Apache-2.0); the statements, conversations and page are this repository's.

The ontology is written for this example in the format of the Neo4j Ontology Graph Specification 1.1.0 (neo4j/ontology-graph-spec, Apache-2.0); the specification's SDK validates it in the example's regression run and is not shipped.
